dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: She turns, walking backwards playfully toward the kitchen, not noticing his shoe on the floor.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: He notices her about to trip over his shoe.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: One step too late... She trips. Stumbles. Crashes to the floor. Ronnie lunges to catch her but is too late.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: The Tamagotchi, resting on the laptop, lights faintly. The screen flickers, code scrolling.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: Tori fades in and out of consciousness. In one flicker, she briefly sees the older man instead of Ronnie--lined face, weary, BGA hoodie. Then back to young Ronnie.

dialog.speaker: narrator
dialog.text: Her hand reaches weakly for him before everything goes dark.
